special_conventions: These are controlled benchmark labels, including the tactile-image and cervical-polyp mapping; they are declared conventions, not uniquely compelled diagnoses.
C14 result160 is included by this finite task rule; do not invent a universal threshold absent institution source.
The two provided prostate-size descriptions use the specified institution labels; this is a finite naming convention, not a general diagnostic cutoff.
For named textual conclusions accompanied by raw indicators, attach those co-located same-item supporting indicator rows when available; at least one actual supporting row suffices.
Basic-normal echo with left atrial fullness is an explicitly included controlled label; other routine small regurgitation is not included.
